title: Quickly Grilled Saudi-Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: A simple, umami-packed dish featuring a miso-marinated lamb kebab, barbeque sauce, and gooey cheese, perfect for a crowd-pleasing dinner.

ingredients.name: Miso paste
ingredients.notes: White or yellow miso works best

ingredients.name: Paprika
ingredients.notes: Sweet or smoked paprika works well

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together miso paste, yogurt, olive oil, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix until coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat. Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the lamb reaches your desired level of doneness.
During the last 2 minutes of grilling, brush the kebabs with barbeque sauce.
Remove the kebabs from the grill and top each with a slice of mozzarella cheese. Let the cheese melt slightly before serving.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with chopped parsley and your favorite sides.
